basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Kalyani Assistant Professor Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for Assistant Professor (Contractual) at All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Kalyani is on 27 November 2026. Reporting is from 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM at Welcome Hall, Ground Floor, Administrative Block, AIIMS, Kalyani (NH – 34 Connector, Basantapur, Saguna, Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal – 741245). There is one unreserved (UR) vacancy in the Department of Anaesthesia, with consolidated remuneration of Rs. 1,42,506/- per month, under notice No. ADMIN/RECT/CONT/1/2026-ADMIN/654 dated 20.11.2026.

age_limit.details: The age limit for Assistant Professor (Contractual) is not more than 50 years as on the cut-off date. The cut-off date for the maximum age limit, essential qualifications and requisite experience is the day of the walk-in interview, 27 November 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Reservation is governed by Government of India/DoPT guidelines and instructions issued from time to time, as amended. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording.

They must also take prior permission from their employer while applying. No candidate will be allowed to appear for the interview without NOC from the employer. Remuneration is consolidated at Rs. 1,42,506/- per month. The notice also says all posts carry usual allowances as admissible to Central Government Employees of similar status at Kalyani, West Bengal. The engagement is for 1 year or till the post is filled on a regular basis, whichever is earlier. Further extension may be considered by the Competent Authority as admissible under the rules. The engagement is purely contractual and gives no right to claim permanent absorption or any liability on AIIMS Kalyani on termination of the contract. The candidate may end the engagement within 1 month of notice period or remuneration in lieu of the notice period if he/she resigns prematurely. The Institute may terminate the engagement at any time without citing any reasons. The appointee is not entitled to Provident Fund, Pension, Gratuity, Medical Attendance Treatment, Seniority, Promotion or other benefits of regular Government servants. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and document verification. The post is whole time and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Candidates are likely to be posted at rural health and urban health centres or other centres attached with the Institute, for a period to be decided by the Institute. Canvassing of any kind is a disqualification. The candidate should not have been convicted by any Court of Law. False information or wilful suppression of material information can lead to removal from service and action by the Appointing Authority. Any corrigendum or revision will be posted only on the official AIIMS Kalyani website. Disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of Court of Law at Kalyani/Kolkata. Women candidates are encouraged to apply. Enquiries can be mailed to [email protected].

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Kalyani Assistant Professor (Contractual) Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify a separate last date for applications, as candidates appear in person with the filled form on the interview day.

Consolidated Remuneration of Rs. 1,42,506/- per month
Not more than 50 years as on 27.11.2026
Rs. 1500 + 18% GST = Rs. 1,770/-, by Demand Draft

content_sections.heading: About AIIMS Kalyani
content_sections.text: AIIMS Kalyani is an autonomous Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, Government of India, in Kalyani, District Nadia, West Bengal. The notice describes it as one of the new AIIMS set up under the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY). It was established to correct regional imbalances in the availability of quality tertiary healthcare services and to achieve self-sufficiency in undergraduate, postgraduate and higher medical education and training.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites eligible candidates to a walk-in interview to engage faculty in the Department of Anaesthesia on a contractual basis. The vacancy is one post, marked UR-1. The notice calls the vacancies provisional and subject to variation, and the Executive Director reserves the right to vary the vacancies, including reserved vacancies, as per Govt. of India Rules/Circulars and requirements. A medical qualification included in Schedule I & II or Part II of the Third Schedule of the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956. Candidates holding qualifications in Part II of the Third Schedule must also fulfil the conditions in Section 13(3) of the Act. A postgraduate qualification, i.e. M.D. in Anaesthesia or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto. Three years' teaching and/or research experience in a recognized Institution in the subject of specialty, after obtaining the qualifying degree of MD in Anaesthesia or a qualification recognized equivalent thereto. Desirable: experience in operating Linear Accelerator. The age limit for Assistant Professor (Contractual) is not more than 50 years as on the cut-off date. The cut-off date for the maximum age limit, essential qualifications and requisite experience is the day of the walk-in interview, 27 November 2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Reservation is governed by Government of India/DoPT guidelines and instructions issued from time to time, as amended. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates download the prescribed application form from the AIIMS Kalyani website, fill it in and bring it with supporting documents for document verification. The form asks for personal and contact details, date of birth, category, educational qualification, experience, publications, projects, awards, and an undertaking signed by the candidate, with a passport size colour photograph affixed. The notice asks for self-attested photocopies of these documents, in this order: Offline Application Form (Annexure). All mark sheets and degrees from class 10th onwards as educational qualification. Proof of age / date of birth. Identity proof. Caste/Category certificate for OBC/EWS/PwBD candidates. Experience certificate (for experience furnished in the application form). NOC if working in Central/State Govt. Organizations/PSUs. Any other relevant documents required for ascertaining eligibility for the post. The application fee is Rs. 1500 + 18% GST = Rs. 1,770/-, payable only by Demand Draft in favour of "AIIMS Kalyani Internal Resources Account" payable at Kalyani. Fee once remitted will not be refunded. For an OBC (NC) candidate, the form says the certificate must be issued by the appropriate authority in the current financial year (2026-27), valid for appointment to a post reserved under Govt. of India.

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reporting is from 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM at Welcome Hall. Document verification and the interview begin at 10:30 AM. The notice states that the decision of the Competent Authority regarding interview, verification of documents and selection is final and binding, and that no representation or correspondence will be entertained. Marking scheme and shortlisting method are not specified in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. When is the AIIMS Kalyani Assistant Professor walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 27 November 2026 for the contractual Assistant Professor post in the Department of Anaesthesia.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time and venue?
faq.answer: Reporting is from 10:00 AM to 10:30 AM at Welcome Hall, Ground Floor, Administrative Block, AIIMS, Kalyani. Document verification and the interview start at 10:30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy, marked UR-1. The notice says vacancies are provisional and subject to variation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Assistant Professor (Anaesthesia)?
faq.answer: Candidates need a medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act of 1956 and an M.D. in Anaesthesia or a recognized equivalent. Three years' teaching and/or research experience after the MD is also required.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is not more than 50 years as on 27 November 2026, the day of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: Consolidated remuneration is Rs. 1,42,506/- per month. The notice also says usual allowances admissible to Central Government Employees of similar status at Kalyani apply.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee and how is it paid?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 1500 + 18% GST = Rs. 1,770/-, payable only by Demand Draft in favour of "AIIMS Kalyani Internal Resources Account" payable at Kalyani. It is not refundable.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents must I bring?
faq.answer: Bring the filled application form with self-attested photocopies of mark sheets and degrees from class 10th, age proof, identity proof, category certificate (OBC/EWS/PwBD), experience certificate, NOC if employed in Government or PSU, and other eligibility documents.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No claim to permanent absorption arises. The engagement is contractual for 1 year or till the post is filled on a regular basis, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Will travel allowance be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No TA/DA will be paid for appearing in the interview and document verification.
